people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—
translations.bsb: as well as the woven garments, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests,
translations.kjv: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,
translations.asv: and the finely wrought garments, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,
